texts.at_approver_amount: Baza umuntu wa kabiri hejuru y'aya mafaranga
texts.at_approver_note: Nanone iyo impinduka ikora ku bintu birenze {items}. Uwasabye ntiyemeza na rimwe icyifuzo cye.
texts.at_memory_note: Bibikwa kuri ubu bucuruzi gusa. Nta nimero z'amakarita, PIN cyangwa kode. Ntibigurishwa, ntibisangizwa.
texts.at_never_secrets: Ntibyabitswe: bisa na nimero y'ikarita cyangwa kode.
texts.at_not_adviser: Nsobanura muri rusange. Sindi umunyamategeko, umucungamari cyangwa umujyanama; nshobora kuguhuza n'umwe muri bo.
texts.at_pause_note: Ihagaritswe, LynkAssist iracyasubiza ariko nta cyo ihindura.
texts.at_practice_done: Byakozwe mu myitozo. Nta kintu nyacyo cyahindutse.
texts.at_practice_note: Uburyo bw'imyitozo: nta kintu nyacyo gihinduka.
texts.at_roles_note: Ntibirenze ibyo umwanya ubwawo ushobora gukora.
texts.at_roles_title: Ibyo LynkAssist ishobora gukora kuri buri mwanya
texts.at_round_all: Shyira ibiciro byose ku mubare uzengurutse
texts.at_sample: Ibi bihindura ibintu {n}. Dore {shown} muri byo.
texts.at_second_approver: Iri ni impinduka nini, bityo umuntu wa kabiri arayemeza: {role}.
texts.at_sent_approver: Byoherejwe ngo umuntu wa kabiri abyemeze.
texts.at_stopped_content_not_instructions: Ibi byaturutse mu nyandiko LynkAssist yasomye, bityo ntibikorwa.
texts.at_stopped_over_limit: Ibi birenze imbibi nyiri ubucuruzi yashyizeho.
texts.at_stopped_paused: Ibikorwa bya LynkAssist byahagaritswe by'agateganyo. Iracyasubiza, ariko nta cyo ihindura.
texts.at_stopped_register: Ibi bikeneye umuntu cyangwa igenzura rito mbere.
texts.at_stopped_role_off: Nyiri ubucuruzi yabifunze ku mwanya wawe.
texts.at_sure_likely: Birashoboka: inyandiko zimwe ziracyari mu nzira
texts.at_w_cash_mismatch: Amafaranga yabazwe ntahura n'ayo isanduku itegereje.
texts.at_w_duplicate_invoice: Iyi fagitire isa n'iyo wamaze kohereza.
texts.at_w_price_below_cost: Iki giciro kiri munsi y'icyo cyagutwaye ({cost}).
texts.at_w_stock_low: Iki gicuruzwa kiri munsi y'urwego rwo kongera gutumiza.
